shotsInfo.name: Arrive
shotsInfo.note: Kling 3.0 4K, 3 s, job 5e77591d. Round 3: source 52-70 and 72 only. 33-51 show crack-like windshield streaks or bumper smear; every step is a single source step so the car's real ease-out into the stop is kept (steps shrink monotonically: car-region median 9.09 -> 0.69 px at 960 wide, whole-frame 1.82 -> 0.20 at 480).

shotsInfo.name: Prep
shotsInfo.retouch: All frames: yellow masking tape on the sill painted out (reshoot-tools/retouch.notape).

shotsInfo.name: Lay
shotsInfo.note: Kling 3.0 4K, 3 s, job faa59c1e (start: s3 start v2 38b23b21, stiff charcoal sheet, wiper arms removed; end: v2 3fa1981e aligned, sheet ~10 cm lower and still clear of the lid). Kling bobs the sheet +-5-8 px while lowering it; 9 frames picked so the sheet's bottom edge only moves down, in even steps (700->722 px at 1080p), with even whole-frame flow (worst neighbour ratio 1.17).

shotsInfo.name: Edges
shotsInfo.note: Kling 3.0 4K, 5 s, job b22e5de0 (approved s4_start -> s4_end). Kling 4K jitters the heat gun about 6 px per frame around a smooth path; source 18-120, frames by dynamic programming on whole-frame flow and the tracked nozzle and squeegee hand (flow neighbour ratio 1.27, no reversals).

shotsInfo.name: Tint
shotsInfo.retouch: src 15-24: badge-patch shadow under "rrera" removed (desmudge.py). src 15-27: light bar topped up to its src 28 level (lightbar.py). All frames: badge completed to "911 Carrera S" (badge_s.py); the figure behind the rear side glass removed (reshoot-tools/retouch.noface).

note: Engine reads per/shots/count/lens/d/m/l/weights. Every frame is a real source frame at an integer index, chosen so each scroll step moves the picture about the same amount (shots 1-4). Shots whose "lens" is under 40 have no files past it and the engine never asks for them. shotsInfo and stills (1-based files shown under reduced motion) are for reviewers.
